summary: A deadly Indonesian earthquake, Google's Gemini 3.7 Flash launch and an intensifying US-China AI price war lead a day also marked by Taliban anniversary reporting, new game releases and Disney's D23 showcase.

items.title: Powerful 7.7-magnitude earthquake kills at least 38 in Indonesia
items.description: A powerful 7.7-magnitude earthquake struck eastern Indonesia, killing at least 38 people and triggering a search for survivors.

items.title: Introducing Gemini 3.7 Flash
items.description: Google DeepMind launched Gemini 3.7 Flash, its latest fast, low-cost model aimed at high-volume developer use.

items.title: 'I shot Mr Thompson'- What it was like inside court as Mangione pleaded guilty
items.description: Luigi Mangione pleaded guilty in a courtroom account of the killing of a healthcare CEO that drew worldwide attention.

items.title: OpenAI and Anthropic in price war as Chinese AI rivals gain ground
items.description: OpenAI and Anthropic are cutting prices as Chinese AI labs close the gap, squeezing the economics behind trillion-dollar valuations.

items.title: US aircraft carrier on way to relieve USS Lincoln after issues reported aboard
items.description: A US aircraft carrier is being sent to relieve the USS Lincoln after reports of food shortages and broken plumbing among its crew.

items.title: South Korea proposes talks to officially end war with North
items.description: South Korea's president proposed talks to formally end the Korean War, more than seven decades after the armistice.

items.title: BBC seeks to subpoena Trump's family members in Panorama lawsuit
items.description: The BBC is seeking to subpoena members of Trump's family over his intentions in a January 6 speech, in an ongoing Panorama lawsuit.

items.title: Afghan women tell the BBC their lives are unrecognisable after five years of Taliban rule
items.description: Five years into Taliban rule, Afghan women describe floggings, lost jobs and blocked healthcare access to the BBC.

items.title: France's top court blocks social media ban for under-15s
items.description: France's top court struck down a planned social media ban for under-15s as an infringement on free expression.

items.title: Activists try to deliver aid to Palestinians in homes besieged by Israeli settlers
items.description: Activists tried to deliver aid to Palestinian families besieged in their West Bank homes by Israeli settlers for days.

items.title: Meta’s ‘open’ AI, and a $250M deal gone very wrong
items.description: Meta's release of an open-weight model alongside Zuckerberg's 'AI for everyone' pitch coincides with a reported $250 million deal turning sour.

items.title: OpenAI hires new CRO as executive shake-up continues
items.description: OpenAI replaced its chief revenue officer after just nine months, part of a continuing executive shake-up at the frontier lab.

items.title: Hyperscalers might regret embracing natural gas if new forecast proves correct
items.description: A forecast that natural gas prices could triple threatens to hit hyperscalers with huge bills for powering AI data centers.

items.title: Apple in talks to pay publishers to provide Siri with current news: report
items.description: Apple is reportedly considering a nine-figure budget to pay publishers so Siri can deliver current news.

items.title: Suspecting court of using AI, man injected prompts in filings to try to win case
items.description: A judge warned that pro se litigants are misusing chatbots after a man injected prompts into court filings to try to sway an AI-assisted judge.

items.title: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermark from its AI generations
items.description: Google will let users strip the visible watermark from its AI-generated images, though invisible detection marks remain.

items.title: Claude's new Scarlet Letter watermark is invisible—for now
items.description: Anthropic's new Claude watermark flags AI-touched text but remains invisible to users for now.

items.title: The new Instagram logo is the perfect embodiment of AI slop
items.description: Critics say Instagram's new wordmark logo is a perfect, unintentional embodiment of low-quality AI-generated design.

items.title: 20 hours in, I cannot believe the scale, complexity, and ambition of Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave
items.description: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave impresses reviewers with an unusually massive scale and branching choices early on.

items.title: Nintendo announces Pokémon Pokopia has sold over 5m copies, meaning that roughly one in four Switch 2 users now owns the game
items.description: Pokémon Pokopia has sold over five million copies, meaning roughly a quarter of Switch 2 owners now have the game.

items.title: Netflix's gaming "secret weapon" is no more - Oxenfree studio Night School is to close
items.description: Netflix's Oxenfree studio Night School is closing, ending hopes the streamer would back more ambitious games.

items.title: Marvel's Wolverine "fully playable" on disc when it releases, Insomniac clarifies, perhaps making it one of the last few PlayStation games that will be
items.description: Insomniac confirms Marvel's Wolverine will be fully playable on disc at launch, likely one of PlayStation's last such releases.

items.title: EA Sports FC might be getting a proper football game challenger, as 2K sets up new studio to make its "next blockbuster sports franchise"
items.description: 2K is setting up a new studio led by a former FIFA producer to challenge EA Sports FC's dominance in football games.

items.title: Why Aging May Be a Program, Not a Breakdown
items.description: New research on millions of mouse cells suggests aging is a programmed remodeling process rather than random decay.

items.title: Satellite Will Breathe Air to Stay in Orbit
items.description: A new satellite design draws on atmospheric air to stay in low orbit longer, easing the need for onboard propellant.

items.title: AI productivity gains drive net CO₂ increase in global energy–economy model
items.description: A global energy-economy model finds AI productivity gains are driving a net increase in CO2 emissions, not a decrease.

items.title: Disney's D23 2026: All the trailers, news, and reveals in one place
items.description: Disney's D23 2026 event delivered a flood of trailers and reveals spanning Marvel, Star Wars, Pixar and more.

items.title: Marvel’s ‘X-Men’ Reboot Sets May 2028 Release Date
items.description: Marvel confirmed its X-Men reboot's cast and a May 2028 release date, folding the mutants into the MCU at last.

items.title: ‘Ahsoka’ Season 2 Trailer: Ahsoka and Anakin Reunite as Grand Admiral Thrawn Declares War on the Rebels
items.description: Ahsoka season 2 gets a January 2027 release date, with Thrawn declaring war on the Rebels in a new trailer.

items.title: ‘Zootopia 3’ in the Works at Disney
items.description: Disney confirmed Zootopia 3 is in development after Zootopia 2 became its highest-grossing animated film ever.
